simple.summary: חָצוֹת (châtsôwth) means the middle (of the night) First listed occurrence: Exod 11 4.

definitions.full: H2676. chatsoth [ חָצוֺת ] noun feminine (Infinitive form.) division, middle — only construct הַלַּיְלָה חֲצֹת Exod 11:4 (J) = midnight ; לַיְלָה חֲצוֺת Job 34:20 ; Psa 119:62 ; in all = adverb. phrase of time ( בְּ omitted)
